parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human histone acetyltransferase KAT2A. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for target name 'Histone acetyltransferase KAT2A' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require structures. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
